candidates.title: Orla: A Library for Serving LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
candidates.reason: Agent-serving layer with stage mapping, workflow orchestration, and workflow-boundary KV-state management across heterogeneous models/backends; evaluated for latency/cost and TTFT improvements.

candidates.title: Efficient Serving for Dynamic Agent Workflows with Prediction-based KV-Cache Management
candidates.reason: PBKV predicts future agent invocations and uses them conservatively for KV-cache eviction/prefetch in dynamic workflows. Three workflow benchmarks show speedups over LRU and KVFlow.

candidates.title: Scepsy: Serving Agentic Workflows Using Aggregate LLM Pipelines
candidates.reason: Concrete cluster serving system for arbitrary multi-LLM agent workflows, optimizing fractional GPU shares, tensor parallelism, replicas, placement, fragmentation and topology using aggregate execution shares; reports throughput/latency gains.
